installer.isolation_behavior: rename existing plugins to plugins.before-secret-emko.<timestamp>, create a clean active plugins folder, migrate only compatible ReShade loader and reshade-shaders content
installer.rollback: restore the original plugins folder automatically when a first-time isolated install fails
installer.uninstall: snapshot the SECRET EMKO environment, then restore the original plugins folder when one existed

hardware.forced_override: ForceNeuralStack exists for expert testing but is not a support claim

multiplayer.policy: respect FiveM server plugin policy, Pure Mode, anti-cheat and ReShade restrictions

core.policy: latest official Full Add-on Support at install time

effects.policy: latest packages referenced by shipped presets; unavailable external techniques are disabled locally

runtimeCritical.policy: pinned and SHA-256 verified until separately validated
runtimeCritical.reason: DLSS/NR/Bridge binary compatibility is more important than blindly following newest assets
